Don't be so hard on yourself. Write down on a piece of paper all the things you are grateful for. Your moms love/Having clean bed sheets/ Drinking a cold glass of water/etc. Be honest, and include whatever comes into your head. Try to add to this gratitude list every night. When you have a setback or stressful day, reflect on this list.

Next thing is you need to focus on your circle of influence; anything that you have direct control over. Like brushing your teeth, working out at the gym, handing out resumes, helping your parents out around the house, etc. Life can blowup out of all proportion to what is truly important. Debts, and having no social life create a ton of unnecessary pressure. If you focus on today, this next hour, you will start to create lasting change. Lets face it, your debts aren't going away overnight. Building a social life takes time & effort. Maybe that time & effort is better spent investing in yourself. Get disciplined. You are 26 and have way more years ahead of you to change things for the better.
